The '''Sheela system''' was located in the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Sheela Run]].<ref name="GunsNarHekka">{{TCWComicCite|6.13|The Guns of Nar Hekka}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Sheela [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed it in grid square S-15.<ref name="EAOC" />
